messages:
Ava Lopez: Quick check-in — weekly account health for Atlas onboarding. Noticed token spike Wed night and throughput drop during the same window. Quick numbers below, can folks chime in on causes/next steps?

Miguel Chen: Thanks. Can you paste the time range + query?

Ava Lopez: Sure — pulled from telemetry 2026-03-11 00:00 -> 2026-03-17 23:59 UTC. Summary:
```
- Tokens WoW: +43% (mainly completion tokens)
- Throughput (req/s) WoW: -21% peak -> avg
- 95p latency: 220ms -> 380ms (spike)
- Error rate: 0.8% -> 2.7% (Wed 02:12-03:10 UTC)
- Spend WoW: +37% (billing spike)
```

Ava Lopez: Notable: spike correlated with a canary group that started heavier eval traffic; caching bypassed.

Zoe Park: @Ava can you share route/id? I can check model variant and cache policy.

Ava Lopez: route: /generate/atlas-corp-main, model: redwood-open-1.3-q4 (quantized), rollout: canary-5%. Canary started Tue 22:00 UTC. Logs show KV cache misses in canary.

token-monitor-bot: Alert: Elevated token consumption detected for route /generate/atlas-corp-main — +43% WoW. See dashboard: https://console.redwood/atlas/usage

Miguel Chen: Also seeing increased embed requests from onboarding sandbox — likely from customer QA harness. @Priya any enablement sessions last week?

Priya Nair: Yes, did a live demo Thu morning. They ran batch evals against earlier prompts, might explain heavier completions. I asked them to pause overnight runs.

Zoe Park: Ops suggestion: roll back canary to 1% and enable prefix caching for that route. Also add a burst throttle for eval client id.

Ava Lopez: Agreed. Proposed actions:
1) rollback canary -> 1% (Zoe)
2) enable prefix/KV caching (Zoe)
3) add burst throttle to onboarding client id (Miguel)
4) follow-up with Atlas PM + note renewal risk if spend continues (Priya)

Miguel Chen: Done — rolled back to 1% at 1934567892. Confirming throttle patch queued.

Zoe Park: Enabled caching at 1934567894. Monitoring latency.

token-monitor-bot: Info: Throttle rule applied to client_id atlas-onboard (rate limit: 10 req/s burst 40). Dashboard: https://console.redwood/atlas/routing

Ava Lopez: After changes: latency trending down 95p -> 240ms, error rate down to 0.9%, tokens back to +8% WoW. Spend still elevated but should normalize.

Priya Nair: I'll reach out to Atlas PM to recap and propose cost guardrails. Noting renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks — flagging as "medium" risk for overage concerns.

Ava Lopez: Thanks team. I'll close this thread after tomorrow's snap if metrics hold. :thumbsup: 

Miguel Chen: lgtm

Zoe Park: 👍

Priya Nair: 👍
